```{r}
ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "AirBnB : New York",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    card(
      card_header("Price"),
      sliderInput(
        "price",
        "Set value",
        min = 0,
        max = 10000,
        value = c(0,10000)
      ),
    ),
    card(
      card_header("Type of room"),
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "room",
        "Select all that apply",
        choices = list("Entire home/apt" = "Entire home/apt", "Private room" = "Private room", "Shared room" = "Shared room"),
        selected = 1
      ),
    ),
    card(
      card_header("Neighbourhood group"),
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "neighbourhood_group",
        "Select all that apply",
        choices = list("Bronx" = "Bronx", "Brooklyn" = "Brookyn", "Manhattan" = "Manhattan", "Queens" = "Queens", "Staten Island" = "Staten Islander"),
        selected = 1
      ),
    )
  ),
  card(leafletOutput("map"))

)


# Define server logic ----
server <- function(input, output) {



dataFiltered <- reactive({
  req(input$price, length(input$price) == 2)

  airbnb_clean %>%
    filter(dplyr::between(price, input$price[1], input$price[2])) %>%
    { if (!is.null(input$room) && length(input$room) > 0) filter(., room_type %in% input$room) else . } %>%
    { if (!is.null(input$neighbourhood_group) && length(input$neighbourhood_group) > 0) filter(., neighbourhood_group %in% input$neighbourhood_group) else . }
})


  
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  
  df=dataFiltered()
  
  long=c(df$longitude)
  lati=c(df$latitude)
  name=c(df$name)
  
  leaflet(options=leafletOptions(
  minZoom = 10,
  maxZoom = 18,
  dragging = TRUE
)) %>%
  
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron")%>%
  setView(lng = -74, lat = 40.7, zoom = 11)%>%
  setMaxBounds(
    lng1 = -73.7,
    lat1 = 40.92,
    lng2 = -74.3,
    lat2 = 40.4
  )%>%
  addMarkers(lng=long,lat = lati,popup = name,clusterOptions=markerClusterOptions(
showCoverageOnHover = TRUE,
zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE,
spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
removeOutsideVisibleBounds = TRUE,
freezeAtZoom = FALSE
) )
  })
}

# Run the app ----
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Option 1: prendre les groupes présents dans filtered_data
groups <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(filtered_data$neighbourhood_group)))

# Option 2 (si tu veux forcer l'ordre fixe des 5 groupes connus) :
# groups <- c("Bronx", "Brooklyn", "Manhattan", "Queens", "Staten Island")

plots_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  df <- subset(filtered_data, neighbourhood_group == g)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    # Graphique "vide" si le groupe ne figure pas dans les données filtrées
    return(
      ggplot() + 
        theme_void() + 
        labs(title = paste("Aucune donnée pour", g))
    )
  }
  ggplot(df, aes(x = reorder(neighbourhood, price, FUN = median), y = price)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    coord_flip() +  # plus lisible avec beaucoup de catégories
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution des prix par neighbourhood —", g, "(échelle log)"),
      x = "Neighbourhood",
      y = "Prix (log)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
})

names(plots_by_group) <- groups

# 👉 Afficher tous les graphiques l'un après l'autre (RStudio les affichera à la suite)
for (p in plots_by_group) print(p)
```
